owner_brief: 2026-10-03: "TOWN SQUARES AND TRADERS. Finish them properly. Market squares, stalls, the civic centre of each town. Several still read as streets with buildings rather than places with a middle ... every town should have somewhere a player goes to spend money."

contract.with: the trader builder (data/traders.json, data/markets.json): it stands a keeper at each stall's keeper_at
contract.square: {rect: [x0, z0, x1, z1], y: <the floor block's y>, centrepiece: [x, y, z]}: on a plaza the rect and y ARE the plan's plaza (data/placements.json plan.plaza; the build refuses otherwise); the centrepiece is the piece's origin, y its first block above the floor
contract.stalls: [{id: <town>_stall_<n>, at: [x, y, z], facing, keeper_at: [x, y, z, yaw], sells}]: `at` is the tent's table, its middle block; `facing` is the side the customers stand on; `keeper_at` is where the keeper's FEET go, IN FRONT of the table, at at + step(facing), the tent's open front (2026-10-04, the owner: the old booth's counter kept the keeper out of reach); the customer stands at at + 2 step(facing), face to face, nothing between: the block below it is the floor, it and the block above it are air; yaw faces the customers (Minecraft yaw: 0 south, 90 west, 180 north, -90 east); `sells` is the stall's theme word, a key of `goods`
contract.checked_by: tools/plaza_centre.py build recomputes every at, keeper_at and centrepiece from the piece it builds and refuses on any difference

rules: every piece inside its square, off every street, lot, anchor, building, earthwork, lamp, waystone pad, street mouth, door apron, desire line, NPC, walked route line, signpost and dressing piece of its town (tools/plaza_centre.py docstring); furniture over at most coverage_max of the square; no block data/spawn_blocks.json lists; every cell of the square lit in the model; every stall, the centrepiece and every bench reachable on foot from the Centre's and the Mart's doors

blocks.note: Every block a piece may write. Vanilla 1.21.1 ids only, each checked against the client jar's blockstates by `python tools/plaza_centre.py check-ids`; none is a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json (the build refuses one)

The belvedere is a view; the relay pylon at its east end and a sighting post aimed at the array give it a middle, and two stalls bring the relay stores up from beside the Mart, 40 blocks down the walk. End rods crown the mast, never a lightning rod (a spawn condition).

gym5_town.name: Fenhide
gym5_town.why: The fen-edge watch town. Its plan calls this the market yard, and nothing was on it; it lies between the Centre (north-west) and the Mart (south-east), so it is the town's middle by position. The dry well ("the fen water is not for drinking") in mud brick under a mangrove roof, three stone lanterns on the west edge in line with the way to the boardwalk, and four stalls on the east band for the trackers' outfitting, smoked game, reeds and the watchers' balls.

centrepiece.why: the dry well: mud-brick rim, capped, under a mangrove roof

stalls.why: the Tracker's Outfitter: pickup and magnet upgrades, the Mega Bracelet
balls for watchers in the reeds

links.why: the high street passes the yard's south-west corner three blocks off: three blocks of the yard's own cobble join them, so the walk from the street, the Centre and the Mart reaches the yard on paving

gym6_town.name: Tilpey Cross
gym6_town.why: The region's place of study, and the only true square in the region. The crossing stays flat: the eye is laid in carpet on the paving of the north-east bay, quartz plinths stand in the corner bays, and four stalls stand in the bays for the archive's stores, produce, herbs and battle items.

centrepiece.why: the eye, flush on the paving: memory and perception

stalls.why: the Archive Stores: smithing and stack upgrades, Twisted Spoon, Ultra Balls

pieces.why: lights a part of the square no other light reaches

gym7_town.name: Cinderlee
gym7_town.why: The research town on the crater rim, whose ash square is a crossing between the Centre (north) and the Mart (south). The ember brazier stands in the south-east bay, south of the causeway line so the view east to the gym stays open; Blaine's quiz board, and four stalls for the ironmonger, the core samples, the field kitchen and the smithy. No magma, no lava (spawn conditions).

centrepiece.why: the ember brazier: a raised blackstone basin, the fire two blocks up

stalls.why: the Rim Ironmonger: gold pack, furnace upgrades, Charcoal
